description:
Laragon - fast & powerful local development environment

Laragon is a portable, isolated, fast & powerful universal development environment for PHP, Node.js, Python, Java, Go, Ruby.
It is fast, lightweight, easy-to-use and easy-to-extend.
It is great for building and managing modern web applications.
It is focused on performance - designed around stability, simplicity, flexibility and freedom.
Laragon is very lightweight and will stay as lean as possible.
The core binary itself is less than 2MB and uses less than 4MB RAM when running.
Fixed and improvements:
• Update Apache to the latest version 2.4.69-261002-Win64-VS18
• Update PHP 8.3 to the latest version, 8.3.36 (Critical Security Fixes)
• Update Nginx to the latest version 1.30.6
• Update Node.js 22 LTS to the latest version 22.23.4
• Update Composer to the latest version 2.10.3

Notes:
• To use Laragon's bundled **PHP, Node.js, and Python** in any Terminal, code editor, or IDE, simply click  **Tools > PATH > Add Laragon to PATH**.

• Smoothly upgrade from older version of Laragon to Laragon 8:
Please follow this guide：https://github.com/leokhoa/laragon/discussions/1059 

• Smoothly update to the latest version of Laragon：Just download and run  **`LaragonUpdater.exe`**

Laragon supports both versions of phpMyAdmin:
1. **Menu > MySQL > phpMyAdmin**：phpMyAdmin 5
7. **Menu > MySQL > phpMyAdmin6**：phpMyAdmin 6 - This version works with PHP 8.4+
